name: Doug Robb
title: Candidate for West Valley-Mission Community College District Board of Trustees, Area 7 (2026); San Jose City College instructor
background: Robb has taught kinesiology and health education at San Jose City College since 1994 and coaches baseball at the community-college level; his campaign cites nearly 35 years of teaching, including middle school, and faculty leadership roles at San Jose City College. He describes himself as a product of the California community college system. His ballot designation is "College Professor/Coach". (Campaign website; Santa Clara County Registrar)

He is running on smaller classes and more sections, shifting hiring from administrators to faculty and student-facing staff, and giving faculty and staff more say in district decisions. He is endorsed by the San José/Evergreen Federation of Teachers (AFT 6157). This research did not find any prior elected office. (Campaign website; AFT 6157)
